claims.statement: The CLI entrypoint (cli.py) registers a Click command group with global options (--environment, --aws-profile, --context-file, --target-region, --verbose) and commands generate, deploy, delete, cleanup, init; it dynamically attaches inspect and local subcommand groups in main().

Generation is orchestrated by generate.generate(), which calls load.resources() to build a benedict from resources.yaml plus recursively imported easysam.yaml files, then renders template.j2 and swagger.j2 via Jinja2, optionally invokes plugins, and optionally generates Prismarine clients; the standard return contract is ProcessingResult (tuple[benedict, list[str]]).

load.py is the core loading engine: it reads resources.yaml, loads .env, resolves !Conditional tags against the deploy context, applies overrides from context, recursively imports easysam.yaml files from import directories, preprocesses Prismarine tables, applies defaults, sets enable_lambda_layer from the existence of thirdparty/, and sorts sections; the result is validated against schemas.json (global) and local_schemas.json (per-file).

deploy.py is a SAM CLI wrapper that runs generate, checks pip/SAM CLI versions, removes and copies common dependencies via AST-traced commondep(), runs sam build and sam deploy with tags/region/profile, then reconciles event source mappings for pollable functions; delete uses CloudFormation delete_stack with optional FORCE_DELETE_STACK.

The local execution surface (easysam local) is implemented across local_cli.py (Click group for server + invoke), local_server.py (FastAPI factory with envvar save/restore and an asyncio invocation lock), local_routes.py (RouteInfo + build_routes for API paths, greedy catch-alls, and /__fn/ function URLs), local_handler.py (isolated import context and load_and_invoke), and local_event.py (REST v1 / HTTP v2 API Gateway event builders).

template.j2 and swagger.j2 are first-class code-generation surfaces: template.j2 renders template.yml (SAM/CloudFormation) and swagger.j2 renders build/swagger.yaml (OpenAPI/Swagger for API Gateway) when paths are defined; both receive the resolved resources_data benedict as their render context.
